| PCB / MTD CALCULATION & CONTRIBUTION GUIDELINE |  |  |  |
| This sheet is the control guide for PCB/MTD and CP38. It prevents dangerous direct overwrite by requiring a verified calculation source, evidence reference, verifier and remittance record. |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |
| A. Core principle | Control rule | How this Google Sheet applies it | Why it matters |
| PCB / MTD is not a flat percentage | Use HASiL-approved method or verified payroll output | 05\_PCB\_CP38 stores verified monthly result; 06\_PAYROLL\_REGISTER only retrieves the verified result | Prevents unverified zero or manual guessing |
| Blank is not zero | A blank PCB field means PCB not verified | Dashboard and payroll register show PCB NOT VERIFIED until evidence is complete | Avoids under-deduction risk |
| Direct override is emergency only | Override must have reason, evidence, approver and date | 04\_PAYROLL\_INPUT override audit flags EVIDENCE REQUIRED | Keeps audit trail transparent |
| CP38 is separate from normal PCB | CP38 applies only where there is a specific additional tax deduction instruction | 05\_PCB\_CP38 has CP38 Amount and 05B\_PCB\_REMITTANCE includes it in total remittance | Prevents mixing normal PCB with directed tax instalments |
|  |  |  |  |
| B. Accepted calculation sources | Allowed source | Use case | Required evidence |
| 1 | AutoCount ACPayroll final PCB output | Transition continuation where AutoCount already calculated the employee PCB | AutoCount report/export, payroll month, employee ID and approved batch reference |
| 2 | HASiL e-Jadual PCB / e-PCB / e-CP39 / current HASiL portal method | Manual verification or employer without a fully approved payroll calculation engine | Submission/calculation screen, batch/reference number and verifier |
| 3 | Approved computerized payroll calculation method | When the system is formally configured and verified against HASiL method | Approved system output, source period, rule version and reviewer |
| 4 | Approved Manual | Exceptional correction only | Written reason, supporting document, approver and approval date |
|  |  |  |  |
| C. Data needed before PCB can be verified | Required data | Examples / explanation | Where to keep evidence |
| Employee identity and tax profile | Tax number, residency, marital status, spouse status, children, disability category if any | Affects relief and tax category | Employee tax profile / HR file |
| Current-month remuneration | Normal remuneration and additional remuneration such as bonus, commission, arrears or taxable allowance | PCB may change when additional remuneration is paid | 04\_PAYROLL\_INPUT and payroll register |
| Year-to-date values | Accumulated remuneration, accumulated EPF, accumulated PCB, prior employment TP3 if applicable | Needed for proper computerized PCB calculation | Tax profile / TP3 / prior payroll records |
| Reliefs and deductions | Approved TP1 reliefs, zakat, EPF and other allowable items | Do not assume relief without employee declaration and approval | TP1 / zakat proof / approval file |
| CP38 instruction | Specific HASiL instruction to deduct additional tax from salary | Only applies to instructed employees | CP38 notice or approved instruction |

| D. Monthly workflow | Step | Action | Control result |
| 1 | Lock payroll earnings first | Confirm gross pay, additional remuneration and statutory wage bases in 06\_PAYROLL\_REGISTER | No PCB calculation before payroll earnings are ready |
| 2 | Calculate PCB outside the register | Use AutoCount final PCB, HASiL e-Jadual/e-PCB/e-CP39/current portal, or approved payroll method | The register does not guess PCB |
| 3 | Enter verified figures | In 05\_PCB\_CP38 enter PCB Amount, CP38 Amount, Zakat Offset, Calculation Source and Reference / Batch | Net PCB = MAX(PCB Amount - Zakat Offset, 0) |
| 4 | Complete verification | Set Verified = Yes only after evidence is checked; fill Verified By and Verified Date | Evidence Control becomes OK / READY |
| 5 | Review remittance | 05B\_PCB\_REMITTANCE summarises by company: Net PCB + CP38 = Total to Remit | Submit/pay only if no open PCB controls |
| 6 | Record payment evidence | Enter CP39/e-PCB reference, submitted by/date, payment method, payment reference, payment date and amount paid | Payment Control should become PAID / READY |

| Net PCB | \=MAX(PCB Amount - Zakat Offset, 0) | 05\_PCB\_CP38 column H | Amount deducted as PCB after allowed zakat offset |
| Tax total on payslip | PCB Net + CP38 | 06\_PAYROLL\_REGISTER AQ | Total tax-related deduction line |
| Payroll retrieval | SUMIFS by Payroll Month + Employee ID | 04\_PAYROLL\_INPUT AA:AC and 06\_PAYROLL\_REGISTER | Ensures the payroll line only pulls its matching monthly PCB record |

| 1 | Company\_Registry | Keep legal employer details complete: EPF, SOCSO, EIS, LHDN, bank and address. | Payslip and statutory reports must use the correct employer identity. | Company code is the master key. | Required |
| 2 | Payroll\_Group\_Map | Map each AutoCount payroll group to the legal company code and cost centre. | Avoid mixing department/cost centre with legal employer. | Staff\_Master company derives from this map. | Required |
| 3 | Staff\_Master | Confirm employee eligibility/category: EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB mode and SOCSO category. | Different employee categories can change statutory treatment. | Do not infer solely from salary. | Required |
| 4 | Payroll\_Input | Enter monthly attendance, allowances, overtime and exceptions. | Keeps monthly payroll change separate from master data. | White cells are input; shaded cells are formula/control. | Monthly |
| 5 | PCB\_Maintenance | Paste/enter verified PCB and CP38 from AutoCount/LHDN source and set Verified = Yes. | PCB cannot be safely forced to zero without tax/YTD profile. | Payroll retrieves by month + employee ID. | Monthly |
| 6 | Payroll\_Calculation | Review payroll rows, SOCSO core/SKBBK split, PCB verification and action status. | This is the computation register. | No unresolved ACTION REQUIRED before approval. | Review |
| 7 | Company\_Summary | Review company totals before payment and statutory submission. | Supports multi-company payroll release and reconciliation. | Each company total is formula-driven. | Review |
| 8 | Payslip\_Print | Select employee ID or name, then export/print A1:H42 as PDF. | Clean payslip output with earning/deduction/company clarity. | Use selected employee selector at row 3. | Output |
